title: Samsung Plans Second Texas Chip Fab in $37 Billion Expansion
gist: Samsung plans a second fab (Taylor Fab 2) in Taylor, Texas as part of a >$37B Central Texas investment, with construction from late 2026 and mass production targeted for 2030; reports say it will make HBM base dies for AMD and Nvidia, alongside 2nm expansion at Taylor Fab 1 and an FD-SOI expansion in Austin.

insights.claim: Samsung Electronics plans a second semiconductor factory, Taylor Fab 2, in Taylor, Texas, as part of a Central Texas investment exceeding $37 billion.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Adds leading-edge US capacity and equipment demand over 2026–2030.
